covered_report_window.description: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the Tuesday, September 8, 2026 close and before the Wednesday, September 9, 2026 open

market_context_summary: Risk-off intraday backdrop: higher oil and Treasury yields revived inflation and Fed-hike concerns. No major Wednesday pre-open U.S. release is scheduled, but Thursday PPI and Friday CPI raise guidance sensitivity.

consensus_method.disparity_formula: ((max direction - min direction) / 4) + ((max reversal risk - min reversal risk) / 2)
consensus_method.method_update: Applied recurring expectation-bar, key-metric-first, forward-look override, and separate reversal-risk controls. No new framework change was warranted.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Positive traffic and ticket momentum, a low valuation, and short crowding favor upside if comparable sales hold.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Comparable sales beat a modest bar while margin and guidance hold.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Inflation and discretionary pressure reverse first-quarter momentum.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public social option estimate near 8.5%; short-crowding evidence is supportive but secondary.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: First-quarter performance led management to raise the low end of full-year guidance.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Preliminary profit is dominated by investment gains while core sales are sharply lower, favoring a negative quality read.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Complete results follow preliminary net sales of $780-$800 million and operating income of $150-$170 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Cash, eBay exposure, or capital-allocation news fuels a relief rally.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Investors look through investment gains to shrinking retail sales and dilution.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Meme positioning and explicit short-squeeze sensitivity make opposite-direction action plausible.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Traditional sell-side estimate relevance is limited by preliminary disclosure and asset-driven earnings.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Five quarters of top-line growth and broad solution momentum support an upside bias if fee revenue remains resilient.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS $1.36 and revenue about $737.7 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Fee revenue and margins beat as search and interim demand stays firm.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Hiring caution and AMS integration costs weaken margins or outlook.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move figure found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Recent evidence is operating momentum rather than a documented broad revision wave.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong volume is not enough if oversupply and weak pricing continue to compress per-unit economics during Calavo integration.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $0.12; management previously guided Q3 adjusted EBITDA to $28-$32 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Calavo contribution and better fruit-size mix lift EBITDA above the guided range.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Low avocado prices and integration costs keep margins weak.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Reliable current implied move was not found; liquidity is lower than large-cap peers.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Evidence is mixed around acquisition benefits versus commodity-price pressure.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Bookings checks and 30% RPO growth favor upside, but the post-earnings rally and tough comparisons require a clean raise.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $0.15 and revenue about $220-$224 million.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings, larger deals, and retention support another raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Growth deceleration or conservative guidance overwhelms a modest beat.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Double-digit implied move reported; shares rallied more than 20% after the prior print before falling sharply today.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Wall Street remains bullish and channel checks indicate improving bookings.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The prior beat-and-raise creates a demanding bar while high-rate conditions punish premium software if guidance merely meets.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $0.35; first-quarter revenue was $268.8 million and Q2 guidance was above prior consensus.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Bookings and Max/AI adoption drive another material raise.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Guidance fails to clear the elevated buy-side bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Double-digit implied move and heavy event premium make a small beat insufficient.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Prior results triggered target increases and a raised full-year revenue outlook.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Excellent inside-sales execution supports upside, but a 43x trailing multiple and record-like setup require more than a routine beat.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $6.75; FY27 inside same-store sales guide is 2%-5% with margin above 42%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Prepared food and traffic keep inside comps near the top of guidance.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Fuel margin normalizes or the forward outlook fails a high valuation bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Preview estimates implied move near 7%; shares trade at a premium multiple.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Strong fourth-quarter execution and an 8%-10% FY27 EBITDA growth outlook set a high base.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Customer additions and margin expansion support upside, but a previously reduced sales outlook keeps the call near neutral.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Active customers, Autoship, and EBITDA margin exceed the bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Management trims sales expectations again as pet-category demand softens.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Public option estimate near 10.65%, implying a large move is already priced.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Consensus remains constructive, but the full-year sales outlook was cut after Q1.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Flat underlying demand and weak cash conversion create downside risk if acquisition-aided growth cannot preserve margin.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $0.92; FY26 outlook calls for $7.8-$7.9 billion sales and $950-$980 million adjusted EBITDA.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Municipal demand and pricing stabilize while buybacks support EPS.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Organic volumes and cash conversion miss despite acquisitions.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable current implied-move figure found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Management reaffirmed rather than raised guidance after the first quarter.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: The same-store-sales bar is achievable, but discretionary pressure, tariffs, and brand restructuring raise the risk of a cautious outlook.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus EPS about $1.74 and revenue $1.53 billion; company guided Q2 comps to +0.5%-2.5%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Comps top the range and cost actions protect margins.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Traffic or gross margin softens under consumer and commodity pressure.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Low valuation and recent share-price weakness raise relief-rally risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Management raised FY27 adjusted EPS guidance after Q1.

research_allocation_view.qualification_rule: absolute consensus score above 30, reversal risk 40 or below, and sufficient confidence/evidence
